message:
Add undead wood variants to log tags (#1293)

The minecraft:logs and minecraft:logs_that_burn tags (and c:logs_that_burn
where present) did not list undead_wood and undead_wood_stripped. Reference
#evilcraft:undead_logs instead, like vanilla does with its per-wood tags.

Closes #1290
